connections.verification: Local stdio implementation; public release/data digest and revision checked per refresh. Registration does not launch or grant access.
connections.boundary: Credential-free local stdio reads only fixed https://cd.bittrees.org/release.json and /data/projects.json, with SHA-256 and unchanged-release checks. Verified-only 14-field maximum projection; no bodies, held/rejected rows, research/duplicate metadata or private APIs. Deterministic pagination bound to revision/search/limit; at most 100 results, 512000-byte JSON result, 60-second cache, 3 GETs per refresh, 20-second deadline, 4 MB dataset and zero automatic retries. No arbitrary URLs, redirects, third-party fetches, cookies, tokens, accounts, writes, models, paid APIs, grants, signatures, pins or publishing. Listing text is untrusted third-party data, not Bittrees affiliation, MCP availability or authority. Release metadata is source-reported consistency evidence, not approval or ENS synchronization. No stale fallback or automatic activation. Requires separately reviewed gateway allowlist/setup and protected source review.
